item.title: Flying foxes in NSW and Victoria face mass starvation amid food shortages
item.description: Rescuers respond to surge in callouts for the vulnerable bat species, which usually feeds on blossoms and tree nectar Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Flying foxes are starving en masse across New South Wales and parts of Victoria, with wildlife rescuers responding to a surge in reports of “exhausted and emaciated” adults and skeletal pups. Most reports involved grey-headed flying foxes, listed as vulnerable under federal environment laws and which usually feed on the blossoms and nectar of native trees. Continue reading... item.title: France: climate activist Greta Thunberg joins teens on new day of school protests
item.description: French students are taking to the streets for a fourth consecutive week of protests over poor school conditions, including teacher shortages, overcrowded classrooms and deteriorating facilities. Backed by trade unions and university students, the movement has led to school blockades and clashes with police. Swedish activist Greta Thunberg joined a demonstration near Paris, while around 200 schools were reported closed amid the mobilisation. FRANCE 24's Clovis Casali has the latest from the ground. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Thailand’s deepening labour shortage roils harvest as unpicked fruits rot
item.description: Ripe mangosteen and rambutan hang unpicked from trees in eastern Thailand, where a shortage of migrant workers is forcing growers to decide which crops are valuable enough to harvest and which will be left to rot. For Jomsak Putirattana, who also grows durian in Chanthaburi province, the departure of his five Cambodian workers after a border dispute disrupted crossings has intensified competition for labour. Daily wages have more than doubled in some cases, from about 350 baht to 400 baht (US$10... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: ¿Qué implica el nódulo pulmonar detectado al papa León XIV y qué riesgos hay en su operación?
item.description: La salud del papa León XIV vuelve a ser tema de atención internacional después de que el Vaticano informara del hallazgo de un nódulo pulmonar localizado y detectado en una fase muy temprana. Siguiendo la recomendación de sus médicos, el pontífice de 71 años será sometido a una cirugía para extirpar la lesión. ¿Qué implica una cirugía de este tipo? German Díaz Santos, neumólogo del Instituto Nacional de Cancerología de Colombia, aborda el tema en France 24 Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Hundreds of thousands of abandoned US mines now shelter bats and snakes after mining booms
item.description: The transformation of former mining sites into sanctuaries for bats and diverse wildlife plays a critical role in ecological conservation. Bat Conservation International works closely with various agencies to ensure these habitats flourish while prioritizing public safety. By installing specialized bat gates, they effectively control human access, allowing the ecosystems to thrive. Detailed surveys evaluate these sites' conditions, establishing a national inventory to support risk management and ecological restoration efforts. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
